<thought>Based on the provided mapped reaction, the retrosynthetic step converts the alkane back to a ketone and hydrazine (NH2NH2). The alkane corresponds to the SMILES “CC(CC)CC”. The corresponding ketone is “CC(CC)C=O”, and hydrazine is “NN”. Therefore the only precursor combination is these two SMILES.</thought>
<final_answer>[["CC(CC)C=O","NN"]]</final_answer>
